source.method_locator: Introduction!A9: IPCC 2021 GWP 100a; Idemat2026!G2:G3: carbon, kgCO2e

permitted_project_use.paid_software: separate SSIM commercial licensing review and agreement required

factors.product_form: cotton fibre trade mix, without global sea transport
factors.geography: source trade mix China, India and USA; not a Korean production average
assumptions: Use the source trade-mix fibre proxy when origin is unknown.

factors.product_form: virgin PET untextured filament / POY production proxy (80-500 dtex)
assumptions: The extrusion process is an incremental process, not a second PET material inventory.
Use a 1:1 pellet-to-output mass proxy; no unreported yield-loss correction is invented.
For labels with unknown production form, explicitly display the virgin untextured-filament assumption.
This is not a measured or global-average factor for all polyester.
excluded: additional drawing not documented in the source process

assumptions: Use the source acrylic-fibre proxy; do not add the PET extrusion process to an existing fibre inventory.

factors.product_form: European scutched flax fibres for spinning linen, source metadata states 12% moisture
assumptions: Use the European flax-fibre proxy for linen; do not map ramie or hemp to linen.

unsupported_material_policy: Reject the whole estimate if any positive-ratio material has no selected compatible factor. Never drop it or substitute a V1/TE value.
cross_version_policy: Keep the original result and source version. Do not present differences between V1, TE research and IDEMAT as emission reductions.
activation_prerequisites: Complete PR 88 input-limit and policy-validation review fixes.
Add executable license/use constraints and actual review metadata to policy administration.
Convert this decision record to a validated deployment manifest; do not pass this file to policy_admin publish.
Expose source attribution, estimate scope, polyester assumptions and free-release restrictions in the app.
Keep third-party reviewer approval separate from this delegated technical selection.
